# DoFlow

> DoFlow is a registry-driven installer (`npx @khoavu882/doflow`) that projects one source of engineering guidance, skills, specialist agents, hooks, and MCP configuration into eight AI coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi, GitHub Copilot CLI, Kiro, and Antigravity. It needs Node.js ^22.18.0 || >=24.3.0; the runtime is TypeScript run by Node's type-stripping, with no build step.

## Get started

- [Home](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/): What DoFlow is, what it installs, and a map of the documentation.
- [Quickstart](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/quickstart/): The shortest path from a clean machine to a verified installation and a first workflow.
- [Setup](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/setup/): Prerequisites, install modes and scopes, updates, backup, rollback, MCP servers, and per-tool mapping.

## Concepts

- [Overview](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/overview/): The component model, session flow, workflow layers, and how context stays small.
- [How DoFlow works](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/how-doflow-work/): The declared execution procedure, the nine task classes, gates, and readiness contracts.
- [Capability Map](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/capability-map/): What each of the eight harnesses supports and where they differ.
- [Enterprise governance](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/enterprise-governance/): Which governance controls DoFlow installs and which only an organization can enforce.

## Guides and reference

- [Guide](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/guide/): Task-based workflows for features, bugs, quality, research, and documentation.
- [Reference](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/reference/): Skills, runtime commands, specialist agents, and git lifecycle intents.
- [Flags](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/flags/): A flag-first index of every skill option and CLI verb flag.

## Contributing

- [Architecture](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/architecture/): Repository structure, the registry/adapter/lifecycle/runtime boundary, and the guard suite, for contributors.
- [Orchestrator spec](https://khoavu882.github.io/do-flow/specs/orchestrator-context-modes/): The design contract for orchestrator context delivery modes.
